definitions.ask: Which keep-work action should a second Enter (⏎⏎) run in the recovery panel?
definitions.why: Escalate is the feature's headline, and like Continue it never releases the workspace

choices.label: Escalate (or Switch at the top rung); Continue only when no other model exists
Continue on the same model; climbing to a bigger model always needs u

definitions.ask: How much of the hijacked transcript should keep-work successors receive by default?
definitions.why: The successor re-explores least, and the budget fallback caps the cost

choices.label: Inline the transcript via #fork; fall back to the brief when over the continuation budget
Send only the bounded evidence brief plus the transcript path; cheaper, more re-exploration

definitions.ask: Publish an Agent Hijack glossary strand when the feature lands?
definitions.requested: An "agent hijack" (aka "hijack"--we should add a good new glossary term for this) is meant to describe the process of killing a sase agent without releasing its workspace or dismissing it.

definitions.ask: Record the two hijack design decisions (never downgrade; custody held until resolved) as decision records?
definitions.requested: Review the agent_hijack_held_workspace_recovery.md file in the research sidecar repo for context and inspiration before planning. I agree with all of the requirements recommended in that research file
